title: Yakuza 5
shortDescription: Massive crime epic spanning five Japanese cities (Tokyo, Osaka, Nagoya, Sapporo, Fukuoka) with five playable protagonists.
historicalSignificance: One of the most gargantuan and ambitious games ever produced for PlayStation 3, packed with mini-games and emotional depth.

sourceReferences: Video Game History Foundation Preservation Archive
